batting.name: SK Rasheed
batting.dismissal: st RD Rickelton b MJ Santner

batting.name: R Ravindra
batting.dismissal: c RD Rickelton b Ashwani Kumar

batting.name: A Mhatre
batting.dismissal: c MJ Santner b DL Chahar

batting.name: S Dube
batting.dismissal: c WG Jacks b JJ Bumrah

batting.name: MS Dhoni
batting.dismissal: c Tilak Varma b JJ Bumrah

batting.name: RD Rickelton
batting.dismissal: c A Mhatre b RA Jadeja

balls.text: Length ball on the pad, he misses the flick and it goes off his pad to short fine leg. CSK take 16 off the last over and finish on 176 for 5
Low full toss on off, squeezed to long-on. This time he gets just one

Whipped away well wide of short fine leg and away from deep backward square leg to get to an important half-century, Jadeja. Full and angling in on the pads, easy pickings for the veteran CSK allrounder
Full tossss, into the stands! This is a yorker gone horribly wrong. On-pace ball into Jadeja, 135.2kph, he clears his front leg and heaves it into the deep midwicket stands
Another yorker, almost nailed it, Jadeja whips it through midwicket. Wants two and that puts pressure on Tilak charging in, fires a wide throw at the bowler's end
Excellent running. Low full toss on off, whipped to deep midwicket. Overton runs on the throw and makes it with a slide at the bowler's end
Low full toss on middle, hit back to Bumrah, 2 for 25 for him tonight
The good ol' French cut! Bumrah can only stare at the batter and offer a wry smile. He has almost nailed the yorker on leg, Overton gets a thick inside edge between his legs and beats short fine leg

Dhoni goes for the biggie, hits it straight to the fielder! A full toss angling in on middle and leg, he flicks it straight down deep backward square leg's throat. I don't think there was a lot of power on the shot, MS trying to use the pace on the ball and just using his wrists. Tilak judges it perfectly, runs in and dives to take that
High=paced, low full toss on off, drilled down to long-on

Low full toss on off, whipped to deep midwicket. Should have been a single but Jacks over-runs it, perhaps because of the spin on the ball. It turns away from him and goes away for four, Bumrah has his hands on his head
Full toss outside off, driven straight to cover

Fired quicker on a length outside off, Jadeja can only slap it down to long-on. Santner completes his three boundaryless overs, perhaps done for the night with the ball? Can't discount another over if these two stay till the end
Nicely looped up outside off, lands it on a length, slows it down to 71.3kph, and gets it to spin away, Dhoni slaps it to deep cover
Darted outside off on a length, slapped straight to deep cover. Smart bowling from Santner this
Flatter and outside off, he goes for the cut but aborts. Wide called
Floated fuller on middle, gets a thick inside edge onto his back leg
Sees Jadeja give the charge and fires it wide on a length. He manages to get back in in time

Huge appeal! Is that close? MI review. Tossed up full on middle, Jadeja gets down on a knee to slog it away but misses. It hits him on the back leg and that perhaps gets Santner and Rickelton excited. Umpire's call on hitting the wickets, and Jadeja survives
Length ball on off, he goes back and punched it to long-on
Low full toss on middle and leg, driven to long-on
Low full toss on middle, whipped to deep backward square leg. It was the slower one at 124.1kph
Full on middle, driven down to long-on
Low full toss, the slower one outside off, he only pushes it tamely to mid-off

Trust Bumrah to break any dangerous partnership! He knows he has outsmarted Dube, who can only offer a wry smile. Bumrah pats him and that's that. Slower one again from Boom, on a length on leg, he whips it high to go over deep midwicket but hits it straight down Jacks' throat at deep midwicket
Slower one outside off, Dube fails to make contact

Jadejaaaaaaaaa! Goes high and long! Once again a length ball angling away on off from around the wicket, easy pickings for Jadeja, who gets the desired room. Lofts it straight over for half a dozen, 24 from the over, just what CSK would have wanted heading into the death
Full and in the slot, heaved aerially towards deep midwicket. Dube slips and gets just one, that is enough to bring up a half-century
No, no no! If you bowl full tosses, they will disappear. Another one at a friendly height from around the wicket, he lofts it straight over long-on, who was briefly interested

Dropped and six! Oh, Bumrah. Was not an easy chance but he's parried it over. A juicy full toss angled in to Dube hip high, he whips it aerially and almost to fine leg, who ran to his right. Turns out he ended up over-running it a bit
Very full outside off, squeezed through cover
Greeted with a boundary! Length ball wide outside off, 128.3kph, Jadeja has enough width on offer and he slaps it over cover
Yorker outside off, jammed towards mid-off for a quick one.
Length ball outside off, cross-bats it down to long-on, had to fetch it from outside off, hence did not connect well. Was the slower one at 125.3kph
Superb effort, Jacks. Another low full toss on leg, Dube flicks it all along the ground to deep midwicket, where he gets around, slides and saves a certain boundary
Low full toss outside off, slapped straight to mid-off

And that DISAPPEARS over fine leg into the crowd! No way you are protecting any side of the ground if you bowl full tosses. That is juicy and on the leg, Dube flicks and gets a top edge that flies. Fifty of the partnership up
Sprays a full toss down leg, he misses
Rocketed down the ground! Full on off, once again Dube clears his front leg and puts Jadeja at the non-striker in his firing line. Jaddu ducks and SKY at long-on had no chance
Slower length ball outside off, slapped to deep point. Just 11 off the over despite that six
Jadeja misses out! Length ball on the pad, he goes for the flick but gets it off the pad to short fine leg. Had he got even a little bat on that, it could have raced away
Full on off, belted past Hardik to long-on

There goes Dube, connects one off the meat and sends it over deep midwicket. He has been trying this for a while now, finally gets one. Full on leg, he clears his front leg and manages to get under it, 100 up for CSK
Full toss angling away from off, hit straight to long-on. Perhaps caught Jaddu by surprise
Full on leg, flicks it aerially on the bounce to deep backward square leg
Another slower one, 121.8kph, this time it is a low full toss. Dube gets a thick inside edge through backward square leg
Slower one down leg, 123kph, Dube doesn't make contact
Very full on leg, flicked through backward square leg
Backs away early, Bumrah follows him with a fuller one, punched down past the non-striker
Length ball on off and middle, clipped through backward square leg
Short and angling in, Jadeja manages to play it fine. Climbs only hip high, he gets inside the line of it and pulls through fine leg. The man in the deep behind square on the leg side was not fine
Bowls it on a length from around the wicket, punched on the up to long-on
Short and off-pace, angling in on middle and leg, Jadeja gets inside the line to pull but misses. Looks to the square leg umps for the wide but it isn't called. And Jaddu doesn't review
Low full toss on the pad again, aiming for the yorker, flicked straight to deep midwicket
Bludgeoned! Finally Dube connects one. Hangs back to the length ball, looked like the cross-seamer. He pulls it through forward square leg and splits the gap in the deep
Another full toss, muscled wide of long-on, Santner does well but cannot prevent two
Low full toss on off, whipped down to long-on
Low full toss on middle and leg, flicked through midwicket
Short and angling away outside off, he stands tall and slashes it to deep point
Low full toss on middle and leg, 132.9kph, Jadeja whips it through midwicket. Jadeja wants two but is sent back in time by Dube
Straight in line of the stumps, very full again, Jadeja defensively drives it back
Full on leg, flicked to deep midwicket
Yorker on middle and leg, 129.6kph, digs it out back to the bowler
Length ball outside off, slightly short, slapped to mid-off
Full on middle, he looks to sweep and it goes behind square leg into the gap. They manage to get two
Tossed up outside off, Dube drives it out to long-off for a single. Jacks getting plenty of purchase here!
On a length around off and this one comes on with the angle. Dube tucks it to midwicket
On a length outside off, Dube stands tall and punches this to the cover fielder
On a length outside off, Jadeja rocks back to cut it away to deep cover
Fires the first one Full on off, gets some turn but Jadeja keeps it out
Punched towards mid-off and Jadeja wants the single but there is a mix-up as Dube sends him back. However, he gets back safe and the throw is off target and they get a run on the overthrow
Low full toss around off, Dube punches it down the ground to mid-off. Hardik fumbles it but they only get a single
ON a length on off, punched to short cover. Pressure building here on Dube!
On a length around middle and off, it holds on the surface a bit as Dube looks to defend. Pops off a little high on the bat but dies on Bumrah
Very full around middle, hint of late movement away, and Dube pushes it out to midwicket
Full outside off, pushed towards deep-ish cover for a quick run

Oh beautiful from Santner, and we have a check for a stumping. And Rasheed is walking! Loops this up outside off at 77.4kph, drawing Rasheed forward, it spins away sharply as Rasheed loses all balance trying to push it towards cover. Rickelton is quick to take off the bails and Rasheed's outstretched back leg is far from the crease! Classic left-arm spinner's dismissal that. Santner damaging his old team, like Chahar did in the previous over
On a length outside off, Jadeja skips down again and punches this straight of Hardik at midwicket
Full and flat on off, Jadeja skips out and clips it to midwicket
Goes back and clips this length ball outside off to deep midwicket
Loopy delivery, full on off, Jadeja pushes this wide of long-on for a single
On a length around off, he goes back and tucks it out to deep midwicket
Full and wide, Jadeja reaches out and eases it to deep point

Deepak Chahar has the last laugh! It's a legcutter on a short of good length and Mhatre slices it off the toe end as he looks to hoick it away. Santner at long-on backtracks and does well to hold on without losing balance! A fantastic debut comes to an end
Short outside off and that's considered too high by the umpire

Chahar pulls his length back and Mhatre punishes him! It's the battle of the No. 56-es and it's the one in yellow who is winning right now. Knuckle ball on a length outside off and Mhatre firmly punches it to the cover fielder's left. Hardik, diving, can't stop it
Chahar nails this yorker outside off as Mhatre can't connect as he looks to jam it out
Looks for the yorker angling in from outside off, slower ball, squeezed back to the bowler
Clattered away! Back of length otuside off, Mhatre clears his front leg and slaps this off the back foot between cover and mid-off! That was aerial but in the gap, and had enough elevation too

This one comes in with the angle and Santner appeals for lbw as Rasheed is late to bring his bat down. They don't bother with the appeal. Replays show that it was pad first, and that it was three reds on ball-tracking!

Manages to get this over backward point and short third! Backed away to this full ball outside off. He was reaching for it as he aimed to go inside out and gets a thick top edge that clears the infield
Full outside off, Mhatre eases a drive to long-off
Tossed up outside off, he works it to backward point but the single is turned down by Rasheed
Floated full on middle, he gets forward to work it leg side and misses and the ball rolls square off his pad
On a length outside off, Mhatre goes back to clip it out to deep midwicket
Short outside off, Rasheed pulls out of the shot. That was a slower bouncer
Rasheed works this through midwicket and picks up a brace
Another good shot, but this time to the fielder! Backs away to the length ball outside off and punches this in front of point, but Dhir does excellently to stop that
And the Mhatre show continues! Dug in short outside off, Mhatre has enough room to flat-bat this back over the bowler's head
On a length around middle and coming in with the angle, Mhatre looks to work it leg side but misses and it bobs back to Chahar off his thigh
Chahar goes for the bouncer, but goes too short. Mhatre looks to pull, but that flies over him
Slower ball, full outside off, eased towards point for a quick run

And he keeps going! Ashwani goes short this time, but Mhatre is up to the task. Gets on his toes and swats a pull over square leg! Almost out in his first ball, 16 runs off his next three. Thrilling debut for the local boy!
Oh what a shot! This is in the slot on the pads and Mhatre just lifts it up and dumps it over deep midwicket! Wristily played there
And that's some way to mark your debut! Full outside off, cross-seam, and Mhatre waits on it before drilling it straight of mid-off!
Full on the pads, tucked out to deep square leg
Ashwani almost gets two in two! Full and angled across, he looks to drive it on the off side and it comes off the outside half and he nearly chips it to the mid-off fielder, but it doesn't carry

And he strikes first ball! Length ball, cross-seam, outside off. Ravindra swipes, looking to go down the ground, but the ball is veering away to take the outside edge and Rickelton does the rest. MI have first blood
And CSK finally get their first boundary! Rasheed gives charge to this short ball outside off and manages to swat it in front of square. This time, Boult has too much ground to cover to his left
Swing and a miss! Bumped in short outside off, Rasheed looks to pull but can't connect
Dug in short, Rasheed stands tall and pulls it square, but still can't get a boundary. Boult this time has to run to his left, and CSK get two more
Full outside off, Ravindra looks to swing it leg side but gets an inside edge that goes to short fine leg's left. Deep square leg does well to race across and prevent a boundary
On a length outside off, punched out to point
Full outside off, Rasheed brings his bat down with an open face to steer it to point
Boult persists with the outswingers to Ravindra, who he has never dismissed in a T20, and Ravindra drives it nicely, but straight to the cover fielder
Leading edge rolls to short third. Rachin comes down the track to this full outswinger and looks to whip it leg side, but it goes off the outside half but along the surface
Another outswinger outside off, Ravindra with another firm drive but can't beat cover to his right
Punched between mid-off and extra cover this time as he gets a length ball around off, Santner gives chase again and saves a boundary

Full outside off, Ravindra this time gets plenty of bat on it as he punches it firmly down the ground, but doesn't get it straight enough of Santner at mid-off, who scrambles across to stop that. They manage to run two
What a beauty first up! Pitches it up outside off, 133kph, the ball swings away to just beat the outside edge as Ravindra looks to cover drive
Back of length outside off with that away movement again. Rasheed meets it with a handsome punch between cover and mid-off for a brace
On a length on leg, finishing on middle. Ravindra taps it towards extra cover for a quick run
Edge doesn't carry! It's full and swinging away from the left-handed batter. Ravindra looks to block and the ball kisses the outside edge but dies down on the slip fielder
First run of the game! This is full on off, with that away movement again, and Rasheed pushes it to mid-off and takes off for a quick single
Full around off, punched to mid-on. This was swinging in from outside off
Punched to cover. This was full and swinging away. Rasheed drives it along the ground to the fielder

Suryakumar seals what is not just a win but delivers a statement. A statement that MI are here and to be never written off. Their campaign might not have gotten off to the perfect start but this is a loud enough win that will wake everybody up, even those who did not have anything to do with them. SKY once again anticipates a full ball, sets himself up for it and sends it sailing over long-off, much like MSD had done one April evening all those years ago but on the other side of the wicket. MI seal a dominant nine-wicket win
MI are in a hurry, SKY is in a hurry, the result is a merry for those watching. This is on off, in the slot, Suryakumar sits deep in the crease leg side of the ball and lofts it inside out over cover
Full on middle, whipped to deep square leg

The Hitman show continues at the Wankhede. A juicy full toss angled in to him, Rohit gets inside the line and swipes it over long leg. What's more, he wants a no-ball for height and opts for the review. Didn't look too high a full toss and it is not, 100 of the partnership up
Spears it full and down leg and Ro watches it through
Quicker and wider outside off, he reaches out and chops it to short third
Suryakumar connects another slog sweeps and those in the deep square leg stand rush to catch that. Once again he uses the long stride to reach it and banish it from his presence
Quicker wrong'un outside off, punched through point
Rohit Sharmaaaa, slogs and connects and takes four! Floated full outside off, he gets down on a knee and hammers it through midwicket
Turns in sharply and takes the inside edge that goes wide of short fine leg. Enough to bring up a 26-ball fifty that gets the MI owners stand up and applaud
The sweep again, like the sweep then CSK changed the ball to a dry one. But little does any of that matter to SKY, who sweeps it in front of square on the leg side

Leading edge and Rohit gets away. He backs away, Pathirana follows him with a full length ball. Rohit goes for the flick but it flies towards deep third, where Khaleel settles under it and takes it but loses his balance. Throws the ball back in and saves a six and gives Rohit a life. Okay, multiple zoomed-in images are used by the TV umpire and one of those show that the tip of his shoe brushes the boundary cushion. Nothing going CSK's way as Pathirana goes for 14 in his first over
Back of a length outside off, he leaves it be, 132.7kph, passes over his head. And Dhoni immediately reviews that, but it is well over
On middle and leg, whipped to midwicket again
Very full on leg, plonks it a touch aerially through mid-on
Yorker on off, squeezed back past the non-striker
Thrashes it through point! This is Rohit Sharma in a mood to toy with the bowling. Backs away, clears front leg by staying deep in the crease, throws his bat at it but trusting his eye
Full toss down leg, he misses the flick
Yorker on leg to begin, flicked straight to short midwicket, where Ashwin fields
Brooming his way to success, SKY! Darted full on middle, swept through square leg for four more, 15 off Noor's second
In the gap. Perfectly. Uses his wrists as the compass. Full on leg, he gets it out of the way and whips it aerially to split deep midwicket and long-on

Another top edge, fortunate Suryakumar gets four, thanks to a bit of misfield from Pathirana. He went for the sweep, got it over the wicketkeeper. Short fine leg hares after it, slides but cannot prevent four
Flatter and on a length around off, he punches it through cover-point off the back foot
Quicker and fuller on middle, defends by getting down the bat hurriedly
Ravindra runs back but gets nowhere near and almost parries it away to the rope. Tossed up wide outside off, Rohit goes for the big one but slices it over cover
Fuller outside off, the Wankhede roars as their raja Rohit Sharma gets to a half-century. A welcome return to runs after a low string of scores. Quietly, though, Ashwin has completed a tidy spell
Another carrom ball on off, punched to deep cover
Carrom ball again, on middle, he backs away and punches it to long-off, 91.5kph

Mhatre!!! Keep him out of the game at your own peril tonight! Saves a certain six. Suryakumar once again uses his reach and swipes it across the line. Was headed over the deep backward square leg boundary but Mhatre gets across, leaps and throws the ball back in play before going the other side. Young man, wanting to put up the best fielding show in CSK colours
Punched off the back foot through extra cover

Carrom ball outside leg, he comes down and backs away and clips it through square leg. And SKY seems to have done damage to his right hand. Looks okay, may have just hurt his hand with his bat while turning at the non-striker's end, the batting getting struck perhaps
Quicker length ball outside off, punched to sweeper cover

Nails the sweep like only SKY can! Didn't look like a sweepable delivery for starters. This is full and outside off, doesn't climb much. But Suryakumar comes forward and just banishes it away to the deep square leg boundary
Fuller on middle, squeezed back to the off side
Quicker and on a length outside off, punched to deep cover-point
Flatter and on a length on leg, clipped through midwicket
SKY sweeps and the W cheers! once again takes a long stride forward and swipes it across the line well over deep backward square leg
Tossed full on middle and leg, driven down the ground to long-off
Full on leg, Suryakumar backs away and squeezes it out to mid-off
Floated full on middle and off, driven down the ground to long-off
Flung full on middle, Surya gets it out to deep midwicket off the inside half of the bat
Short and wide, Rohit cuts it out to the off side sweeper
On a length outside off and going across with the angle, slapped away to deep cover
Dug into the pitch on a length outside off, punched out to deep cover
On a length around off, it spins away sharply and goes off the outside half to point as SKY drives at it
Magnificent! Tossed up on middle and leg, he gets low and nails the sweep behind square!
Matchups be damned! SKY makes room leg side and takes on this full ball around middle and plays that lovely lofted inside-out drive to pick that gap between deep cover and long-off
Full on leg, he wants to sweep but gets it off the bottom half to short fine

Jadeja dives to his right to stop that but can only deflect it to long-on. This was on a length outside off, spinning away. Rohit manages to spoon it back in front. SKY was between Jadeja and where the ball was landing and he gets across and dives one-handed, but it drops just short. Wry smile from the bowler
Tossed full on leg, clipped out to deep midwicket
Chipped just back over the bowler! He looked to flick it but got a leading edge but it's too high for Ashwin
On a length around off, that looked like the carrom ball. Rohit hangs back and works it down to long-on
Rohit nails the slog sweep! Tossed up full, he gives that some air, but Rohit gets low and sends this into the stands past the midwicket boundary
Floated full outside off, it spins in as SKY looks to play the sweep. Almost a catch at short fine, just short of the fielder. A bit of a mix-up as well as SKY is late to run but he makes it safe
Full on the pads, clipped square on the leg side
Tossed up outside off, Rohit lunges forward and flicks this out to deep midwicket
Tossed up on off, SKY works it through midwicket.

Taken on the rope! Ayush Mhatre can do no wrong today! This is tossed up outside off, Rickelton goes for the slog sweep but picks out the fielder. Mhatre takes it above head height and does well to keep his balance!
On a length around off, he rocks back and slaps it out to deep cover
Tossed up on the stumps, Rohit defends
Rohit misses the reverse-sweep and Jadeja with a massive appeal! They don't review it. This was sliding down leg.
Full around leg, clipped to short fine leg
On a length around middle and leg, Rickelton backs away and pushes it to mid-on. Just on the bounce to the fielder
Gets that past short fine leg. On a length on leg and Rickelton gets low and sweeps this to the fielder's right. Good placement
Dances down the ground and flicks this out wide of mid-on
On a length around middle, Rohit stays back and flicks to square leg
Tossed up full on leg, Rickelton brings out the reverse sweep and a misfield by the backward square fielder allows them to take the single

Another biggie for Rohit! Overton went for the pace-off delivery, but it's too full and Rohit smokes it over deep midwicket. And this is his highest score in IPL 2025. He'll want to make this a big one
Overton has missed his line completely there! A wild delivery as he almost bowls it outside the strip. Another wide for the over. 50 up for Mumbai Indians

Off the toe end and it beats mid-on running back! That wide yorker plan works for Overton, or almost does anyway, and he slices it high but gets enough distance on it as Vijay Shankar hares back and dives fbut can't reach it
Rohit loses his shape there! Length ball going across, Rohit wants to swat it down the ground but can't connect. And wide called again
Wide yorker as Rohit looks to come down the crease. He is able to stretch towards it and squeeze it back to the bowler's right
Beaten! Back of length outside off, Rohit looks to cut but the ball flies over the outside edge
Overton looks to take it away from Rohit's arc and Rohit looks to push at it, but it's wide of the tramline
Full around off, pushed wide of mid-off for a quick single
And there's that pickup shot Rickelton loves so much! On a length around middle and leg and it's deposited over deep square leg! Whippage from the South African wicketkeeper
Offbreak on a length on leg, Rohit pushes it to midwicket. Ashwin pulls things back a little for CSK
Dropped a little short around off, he backs away to cut to cover
Length ball slides down leg, but off his pad I think
Floated too full and Rickelton leans forward to turn this into a full toss and tuck it to midwicket
On a length on off, Rohit clips it out to deep midwicket
Length ball around off, fizzed in at 97kph, it's going across Rickelton who misses the ball and it goes square off his hips
Yorker just outside off, squeezed towards mid-on. 14 off that over, all courtesy Rohit Sharma!
Four more! It's the Rohit Sharma show at the Wankhede tonight! Full outside off and Rohit hits it uppishly between cover and mid-off. Excellent placement again from Rohit Sharma
Tucked towards midwicket, says no to the single immediately. Back of length delivery around leg seaming across him
And that's as elegant as it gets from Rohit! Overpitched on off and Rohit caresses it into the gap at cover. What a treat to watch when he is on song!
Huge! Seaming in towards leg stump and Rohit picks it up and deposits it square. It hits the deck of the second tier!
Full outside off, not too much swing inwards, and Rohit drives to Rachin's left at cover, but he stops it well
Full around leg, Rickelton wants to flick this off his pads but misses it altogether
On a length outside off, he taps the slower ball behind point for a single
Into the second tier! You don't bowl there to Rohit! It's short of good length around off and arrives at hip-height for Rohit, who plays that trademark pull to pick it up  behind square!
Back of length outside off, Rohit Sharma drops it towards point. Turns down the single immediately
Pulls his length back but misses the line again. Goes down leg again
Fires this one down leg
Very full on off, pushed out towards mid-off for a single
Full on off, late swing away, Rohit pushes it in front of point and gets off the mark
Full and swinging down leg, Rickelton misses his flick and is hit on the front pad. Good riposte to those two boundaries

Khaleel beats the inside edge again! Full outside off, big swing inside, and it goes off the back pad to the slip fielder. Muted appeal from Khaleel, but that looked like it was going down leg. A replay shows that was hitting leg stump and there was no inside edge either! Missed chance for CSK and Khaleel!
Exquisite placement! Overpitched outside off and he picks out the small gap between cover and point! What a start from him
Crunched away! Makes full use of the width on offer. This is on a length outside off and Rickelton drives it past the point fielder to his left!

Pitched up outside off, hint of away swing, Ricketlton drives it just to the cover fielder's left and Jamie Overton chases from mid-off and dives to stop that. They get two but Overton's knee gets stuck in the ground. He is in some pain
Raps him high on the back leg with his first leg. Length ball outside off jags in to beat the inside edge!
